bugs.title: Required B-fe8f regression cannot read the immutable historical probe rp-mtifubae-dfbh4w in a real worktree

evidence.symptom: Mandatory red-bfe8f-ledger-runtime-integrity.mjs failed because it required historical clone-local candidate cache bytes not present in this real worktree.
reproSteps: Before integration, run node packages/main/tests/red/red-bfe8f-ledger-runtime-integrity.mjs: artifact ref not found for rp-mtifubae-dfbh4w.
Merge independently completed main 874e081862 at 5f2eab09fb, build current main package, rerun the same command.
evidence.rootCause: The regression guard conflated portable checks of committed historical RED references and actual baseline/current execution with availability of old clone-local candidate CAS. Upstream 9b8ca8879f separates historical reference/replay checks from actual current candidate API integrity checks in a private fixture.
evidence.fixEvidence: Exact post-merge command exited 0 with historicalBaselineFails=true currentGreenPasses=true currentCorruptedRelationRejected=true assertionUnchanged=true. Output explicitly declares historicalCandidateCAS=not-consumed liveCandidate=fixture-only restoredHistoricalCAS=false. This closes the mandatory-regression portability defect, not restoration of the historical CAS. Original probe content was independently located in its original reviewer transcript and its digest recomputed exactly; no historical object or timestamp was fabricated. Canonical full validation and other failures remain pending.
